placement.required_memory: V200 pair-managed VMM allocations accessible on both owners
placement.single_owner: submit all rows to the physical owner of the weight extent
placement.two_owner: split at the contiguous preferred-owner extent boundary, rounded up to a complete row
placement.unrecognized_or_unsupported: forward unchanged to the original anchor launch

numerical_contract: Each output row executes the original pinned llama Q4_K kernel exactly once; no floating-point reduction is split or reordered.

verification.behavior: On the first peer-owner and first split route, run the same launch on the anchor as a reference, then run the routed launch and compare the full output bitwise.
verification.diagnostics: V200_PROFILE_LOG receives v200-operator-ledger/v1 route, verification, and process-exit count records alongside frontdoor memory snapshots.

fallbacks: grid.y or grid.z is not one
fused, expert-indexed, batched, or multi-column specialization
input, output, or weight range is not fully pair-managed
weight ownership cannot be proven from the contiguous VMM extent record
the complete weight range is anchor-owned
